subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram album support reuse the existing `send` plus `mediaUrls` message-tool shape, or should OpenClaw accept a separate explicit album action such as `send-media-group` with `filePaths`?
rationale: Current main already has a multi-media URL surface but no native album send path, while the open external draft proposes a parallel Telegram-specific action; repository policy favors avoiding duplicate tool/API paths without maintainer-confirmed direction.

options.title: Reuse `send` plus `mediaUrls`
options.body: Implement automatic album grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and keep non-groupable media on the current sequential fallback path.

options.title: Accept an explicit album action
options.body: Allow a separate `send-media-group` action only after maintainers approve the new tool surface and require docs plus live Telegram proof.

options.title: Defer album semantics
options.body: Keep current sequential multi-media delivery for now and revisit native album grouping when maintainers are ready to own the extra channel-specific API behavior.

recommendation.title: Reuse `send` plus `mediaUrls`
recommendation.body: Implement automatic album grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and keep non-groupable media on the current sequential fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the visible prior reviewer on this exact issue and the clearest current routing candidate for the API-shape decision.
